answer: A jury packed with throwaway keys can rubber-stamp empty work as if it were independent review. A new key must seat a 19-POA marble disk and keep a sparrow heartbeat every 14 seconds on one of 6 perches, each bound to a single pubkey. Peers rebuild the 24-byte perch tag from pubkey, epoch seed, and slot in 0.4 seconds, and evict a second tag on the same perch. The disk stays locked 7 hours and the log is 48 kiB. Two heartbeats 8 ms apart, or a reused disk, burn the perch and stain 35 percent of the stake violet for 3 further epochs, so 50 shells idle 950 POA.
